description:
• Brand introduction:
MYCL Wellness is a holistic supplement brand rooted in the power of functional mushrooms. We make wellness simple and effective with science-backed formulas designed to support energy, focus, immunity, and balance, without the fluff. 

• Product description:
Our lineup includes functional mushroom coffee, fast-absorbing liposomal supplements, and convenient mushroom gummies. All crafted with clean ingredients and whole fruiting body mushrooms for real results you can feel.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):
We use only whole fruiting body mushrooms, not mycelium or fillers, ensuring maximum potency and real benefits. Our products are easy to use, taste great, and are formulated to fit seamlessly into modern wellness routines. 

• Other information:

- Made with clean, high-quality ingredients. 

- Third-party tested for quality and safety. 

- Founded on transparency, education, and customer care. 

- Ideal for wellness seekers, busy professionals, anyone looking for a daily mental and physical boost.
